title: Artificial intelligence and the future of global health

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Artificial intelligence and the future of global health》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Concurrent advances in information technology infrastructure and mobile computing power in many low and middle-income countries (LMICs) have raised hopes that artificial intelligence (AI) might help to address challenges unique to the field of global health and accelerate achievement of the health-related sustainable development goals.

evidence.text: Concurrent advances in information technology infrastructure and mobile computing power in many low and middle-income countries (LMICs) have raised hopes that artificial intelligence (AI) might help to address challenges unique to the field of global health and accelerate achievement of the health-related sustainable development goals.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Artificial intelligence and the future of global health》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】AI-driven health interventions fit into four categories relevant to global health researchers: (1) diagnosis, (2) patient morbidity or mortality risk assessment, (3) disease outbreak prediction and surveillance, and (4) health policy and planning.
